Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

For our client in Meer, we are looking for a maintenance technician.

• As a maintenance technician, you are responsible for repairing technical malfunctions in the production machines.
• The issues can be both electrical and mechanical, but the majority are industrial electrical faults. You are responsible for identifying the malfunction and resolving it.
• In addition, you carry out equipment overhauls.
• You ensure that operators and production staff can continue working at all times.
• Preventive and major maintenance tasks are carried out on Saturdays.
• Furthermore, you make suggestions to optimize the process and proactively prevent malfunctions.

• You hold an A2 diploma in electromechanics or industrial electricity, or equivalent through experience
• You are very proficient in reading electrical diagrams
• You are willing to work in a pig slaughterhouse (you are not required to do any slaughtering yourself, only to maintain the machines)
• You have a good command of Dutch or English
• You are willing to work in a shift system. In addition, you will work on Saturdays and can take a compensatory day off during the week (not on Monday or Friday)
• Knowledge of PLCs and/or I/O configuration (not programming) is a plus
• You are flexible with working hours and can work both independently and in a team
• You are willing to work in varying temperature conditions

Essential duties & responsibilities:
 

· Develop, implement and manage strategic sales plans to accommodate corporate goals.
 

· Assess business conditions by geography and vertical market.
 

· Meet key clients, building relationships and negotiating to bring on new business.
 

· Provide samples, demonstrations, trials and support for prospective and current 

customers.
 

· Identify and evaluate new opportunities.
 

· Generate target list of large end-user customers to pursue. 
 

· Direct and maintain sales forecasting activities.
 

· Manage customer financial management. 
 

· Communicate competitive market pricing.
 

· Attend trade-related events that enhance account relationships and the 

market position.
 

· Maintain close internal and external communication.
 

· Report to the Director Sales and Marketing.

Education & experience:
 

· Bachelor/Master degree in chemistry or equivalent by experience.
 

· Min. 3 years of commercial B2B experience, preferred in a chemical environment.
 

· Knowledge of polymer technology is a plus. 

 

Skills:
 

· Sales relationship builder with “hunting” mindset.
 

· Willing to travel abroad (max 2 weeks per month).
 

· Good knowledge of English and German

The Stack

The client operates in a modern, event-driven microservices architecture:

• Backend & Logic: Node.js, TypeScript, ExpressJS.
• Frontend: React.
• Cloud Native: Deep integration with AWS (Lambda, EKS), orchestrated via Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Helm.
• Data & Streaming: High-performance data handling using Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch.

 

     
What you bring

• Experience: A proven track record in Fullstack development (Node/React) within complex environments.
• Architectural Interest: You understand how a message broker like Kafka fits into a distributed system and you aren’t afraid to touch the DevOps side (Terraform/K8s).
• Mindset: You are a “problem solver” first and a “coder” second. You value clean code, but you value business value even more.
• Communication: Fluent in English; you thrive in a multicultural, high-pace environment.

At Terumo, we advance lifesaving medical technologies to benefit society. Are you eager to make a difference with us? Here, you'll grow your expertise while staying true to your personal aspirations.

Guided by our Japanese heritage, we act with respect, take ownership, and pursue continuous improvement. If you see yourself in our values, keep reading; this might be the opportunity you're looking for.
Department Info

Terumo is a global manufacturer of medical devices, with a strong production footprint in Leuven, where approximately 800 million hypodermic needles and injection solutions are produced annually.  Within the Pharmaceutical Solutions department, we focus on highly customized products developed according to the specific needs, medicines and questions of our pharmaceutical customers. To enable this high level of personalization, Terumo has invested heavily in flexible, highly automated production technologies. Our site proudly carries the title
 Factory of the Future
, recognizing both our advanced production environment and our people-oriented culture. As Senior Production Process Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional production team where engineering, quality, maintenance and operations work closely together to continuously improve processes, yield and quality.
Job Summary
As a Senior Production Process Engineer, you analyze, develop and implement improvements in highly automated production processes to sustainably increase quality, yield and efficiency. You thrive in a dynamic environment where initiative, problem‑solving and collaboration are key. Acting as a bridge between production and projects, you contribute from concept to stable implementation.
Job Responsibilities
 
 
•  Analyze existing production processes to identify, test and implement improvements, and resolve current issues  
•  Optimize production systems with a strong focus on OEE, quality and yield  
•  Define, implement and safeguard process standards, including CP and CPK monitoring  
•  Identify, prioritize and analyze bottlenecks using data-driven insights and structured problem-solving methodologies  
•  Define success criteria and ensure thorough root cause analyses of production issues  
•  Develop, coordinate and implement cross-functional improvement initiatives, ensuring sustainable results  
•  Take an active role in change management through training, procedures and clear communication  
•  Implement and optimize digital systems to monitor and analyze production performance  
•  Act as the link between production and project teams for new installations, from initiation through aftercare  
•  Manage the complete COC process and lead p-FMEA activities, ensuring feedback to SIPOC  
•  Prepare and actively participate in daily production meetings, supporting operational follow-up  
•  Contribute to TPM activities, including maintenance planning and execution  
•  Support calibration activities and perform MSAs  
•  Safeguard inspection readiness and ensure compliance with audit requirements  
•  Participate in internal and external audits, as well as client visits  

 
 
• Master's degree in Electromechanics or equivalent, or a Bachelor's degree with additional relevant experience 
• At least 5 years of experience in production environments with fully automated assembly lines 
• Strong knowledge of process expertise (technology & delivery base, implementation, risks), process control tools (such as 6S), engineering studies and process capability 
•  Basic knowledge of statistics and data analysis  
•  Six Sigma certification (minimum Green Belt)  
• Affinity with PLCs, robotics, cobots, AI or industrial engineering 
•  Open to change and motivated to continuously learn new skills  
•  Proactive in tackling challenges and finding solutions when outcomes are not immediately clear  
• Excellent communication, organizational and project management skills 
• Natural team player who enjoys cross-functional collaboration 
• Fluent in Dutch and English

We are urgently seeking a dedicated Melting Furnace Operator for a leading company in the metal industry.

 

As a Melting Furnace Operator, you play a crucial role in the melting process. You ensure a smooth supply of raw materials and guarantee high levels of quality and safety.

• You accurately weigh the prescribed quantities of raw materials and load them into the melting furnace.
• You follow the production schedule and program the production sequences for optimal productivity.
• You work according to the standard operating procedures and the instructions of the shift leader.
• You participate in 5S and problem-solving events to optimize the process.
• You are responsible for the cleanliness of your work area.
• If necessary, you operate related equipment such as a bulldozer, forklift, and power tools.

Your profile as melting furnace operator; 

• You have industrial experience.
• You are able to work well both independently and as part of a team, even under time pressure.
• You have strong mechanical skills and are comfortable using hand tools. Basic knowledge of power tools, forklifts, and bulldozers is a plus.
• You have an eye for detail and deliver precise, high-quality work.
• You are eager to learn and always open to acquiring new skills.
• Working safely is second nature to you, and you strictly follow all procedures.
• You speak perfect English and French or Dutch and English

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Manager (M/W/D) B2B / Life Science Division (Kaufmann/-frau - Marketingkommunikation)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:
Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Life Sciences

Your Responsibilities:

● Planning, optimizing, and analyzing performance campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads), along with ongoing SEO optimization of our new WordPress website.

● Structured qualification and handover of marketing leads to our sales teams.

● Creating white papers, technical articles, case studies, and web content tailored to decision-makers in the pharma and biopharma sectors.

● End-to-end organization of major international trade fairs (e.g. CPHI, Interphex), including compliance with all booth-construction and logistics requirements.

● Strategic development and editorial planning of our social media activities.

● Monitoring campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experienced in international B2B marketing, combined with a solid technical understanding of the pharma, biopharma, life sciences sector.

● Sound knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, SEO, and analytics tools.

● Fluent, business-level English (written and spoken) is essential — it is our primary working language.

● Very good German (written and spoken) is also required for day-to-day collaboration.

● A structured way of working and strong execution skills when meeting complex deadlines.

● Hands-on experience with WordPress and CRM systems is an advantage.

● Basic graphic design skills for independently creating social media posts and smaller marketing materials are desirable.

● Experience organizing international trade fair appearances.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence

Job OverviewJoin ENPULSION as a Customer Success Engineer (f/m/x) and support our customers throughout their spacecraft missions - from pre-sales, to integration and testing, to on-orbit operations. You’ll act as the key technical partner, ensuring smooth product performance, clear communication, and successful mission outcomes in the fast-growing space industry.

Key responsibilities:
• Act as the main point of contact for project- and program management of key customers.
• Analyze customer requirements and develop compliance matrices to ensure alignment with customer needs and expectations.
• Provide technical support to the Sales team.
• Support customers with integration and operation of ENPULSION products.
• Provide technical support in the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT).
• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of ground support equipment.
• Manage and facilitate customer tests and workshops.
• Initiate, actively support and report on non-conformance processes and anomaly reviews in accordance with established processes.
• Analyze and review on-orbit telemetry, focusing on operator command sequences and thruster anomalies.
• Automate telemetry analysis with Python scripts.
• Recommend strategies and operational parameters based on telemetry and product performance.
• Provide on-orbit operations support to ensure products perform optimally in space.
• Deliver clear, concise, and well-written technical documentation.

Type of contract: Full time position with 38.5 hours/week

Salary : The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2918,14 gross per month, with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Your profile
• Technical or scientific education (FH/University/UAS/HTL), ideally a Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or Mechanical Engineering.
• 3+ years of professional experience in aerospace or a related industry
• Understanding of electric propulsion systems used for satellite mobility is beneficial.
• Knowledge of satellite systems, launch services, or space data platforms is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Solid understanding of electronics design and operation.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes desirable.
• Experience with documentation tools, simulation software, or mission planning tools, as well as collaborative platforms (JIRA).
• Familiarity with space industry standards and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ECSS, ITAR).
• Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written).
• Strong ability to explain complex technical issues to customers clearly and concisely.
• Willingness to travel to customer facilities as needed.
• Proactive, organized, and disciplined approach to independent work.
• Passionate about contributing to a fast-growing business and high-performing team.

Why us?At ENPULSION, you’ll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include:
• 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
• Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining
• Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options
• Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events
• Learning & development budget to support your continued growth
• Firmenradl - Bike Leasing Program
• Office located at VIE Airport City with access to:
• FitFabrik Fitness Center
• Airport Health Center
• Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts
• VIE Community App for news and deals

About usMeet ENPULSION - a Space Tech company based in Wien-Flughafen Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling some of the most advanced propulsion solutions for SmallSats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the NewSpace Area. The teams behind this are full of talented hardworking people, plenty of whom may just be your new lunch buddy!ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, colour, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status.
